apps/admin-worker/component.yaml:
apiVersion: sourceplane.io/v1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: admin-worker
  description: Internal Cloudflare Worker for audited support/administration diagnostics
spec:
  type: cloudflare-worker-turbo
  lifecycle: production
  owner: platform
  domain: starter-runtime
  path: apps/admin-worker
  dependsOn:
    - component: cloudflare-hyperdrive
      mode: enforced
    - component: contracts
      input: true
    - component: db
      input: true
  subscribe:
    environments:
      - name: dev
        profile: verify
      - name: stage
        profile: verify
      - name: prod
        profile: verify

apiVersion: sourceplane.io/v1

metadata:
  name: openproduct-crm
  description: Reusable Cloudflare and Supabase multi-tenant SaaS starter
  namespace: sourceplane
execution:
  state:
    workspace: ws_9JAJMRHA
discovery:
  roots:
    - apps/
    - infra/
    - packages/
    - tests/

    description: Verify-only. Pull requests plan and verify here; nothing is
      deployed, so there is no door.

      main before prod.
    url: https://stage.brokecrm.cloud

      - title: Health
        url: https://openproduct-crm-api-edge-stage.vijayakrishnan12994.workers.dev/health
  prod:
    description: Where customers are. Deploys after stage converges on the same commit.
    url: https://www.brokecrm.cloud
    links:

      - title: API
